definitions: In Hinduism, Nandi is the sacred bull calf, the vahana (mount) of the god Shiva. He is also the gate-guardian deity of Kailasa, the abode of Shiva.
A revered figure in Hindu mythology, often depicted seated or standing before Shiva temples.
examples: Devotees often touch the statue of Bull Nandi for blessings.
The temple courtyard featured a large sculpture of Bull Nandi.
Bull Nandi is a symbol of strength and fertility.
